title: UnifiedEmailParticipant - Data API
description: Represents a participant in an email. This object is available for reports and dashboards in the Winter ’24 release and later.

ActivityId.description: ID of the email the person is participating in. This field is a relationship field.

ChannelAddress.description: Email address of the participant. The email address is captured at the time of the communication; it doesn’t change if the contact’s email address is updated later.

ParticipantType.description: Participant’s role in the email. Possible values are: AssignedTo Attendee BCC CC From OptionalAttendee Organizer To

PersonId.description: ID of the person participating in the email. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.
